input.observed_cancel_sequence: nonnegative-integer: acknowledged by domain settlement handler
input.observed_wake_sequence: optional nonnegative-integer: fixed claim observation, legacy default zero

atomic: release lease and claim authority; retain last holder identity as diagnostic evidence
an unseen cancellation forces immediate availability; acknowledged cancellation may back off while effects settle
an unseen domain wake forces immediate availability; heartbeat observations never acknowledge a domain wake
worker_job.defer.replay: same suspended fencing token, available time, and cursor; no lease or schedule extension

worker_job.request_cancel.suspended: request cancellation, retain suspended state, wake immediately for domain settlement; never mark an active external effect terminal

worker_job.claim_next.suspended: same priority/availability order as queued jobs; new claim advances fencing token and attempt number

invariants: Only a running claim with the matching owner/token and unexpired lease can emit progress or external effects.
Suspension is durable nonterminal waiting. It holds no executor or heartbeat thread.
Cancellation of a suspended job wakes domain settlement instead of completing unknown external effects.
The canonical runner invokes a registered cancellation handler before terminal settlement when a domain requires cleanup.
Terminal domain accounting settles before terminal worker-job accounting.
Claim, defer, cancel and complete update every affected index in the same transaction.
SQLite serializes the writer; PostgreSQL cancel, defer and automation progress hold the current worker row through commit; native OCC validates its current-job dependency.
Only the current backend epoch and backend-owned advancing clock prove or extend a live lease; delayed or forged caller clocks cannot revive one.

leaseAuthority.clock: backend-owned UTC-offset high-water plus monotonic elapsed time
leaseAuthority.lifetime: native/SQLite: existing shared store epoch; PostgreSQL: random named server-shared clock epoch scoped by database OID; never a Sidecar-local UUID
leaseAuthority.callerTime: now_ms is observation/evidence only; never a live-lease proof or lease extension
leaseAuthority.restart: previous-epoch claims fail closed and indexed recovery advances the existing fencing token
leaseAuthority.legacy: empty epoch is non-live; indexed recovery adopts a new epoch without rewriting user state
leaseAuthority.eligibilityClock: backend-owned current UTC; absolute queue availability never uses the advancing lease high-water

wakeAuthority.lifetime: bounded canonical job field; no wake ledger or resident waiter
wakeAuthority.authority: only an owner/tenant-proved domain transition advances the counter and availability atomically
wakeAuthority.claimObservation: captured at claim; never advanced by heartbeat or cached run reads
wakeAuthority.deferral: unseen wake wins over an older requested availability
